title: Regional procurement persona & latency-probe playbook for enterprise model selection
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Objective: Produce an operational playbook that maps enterprise procurement personas by region and ties those personas to latency/economics probe experiments. The output will be (1) a prioritized persona matrix for APAC/EMEA/NA buyers, (2) a set of synthetic latency & fallback probes to simulate buyer-sensitive conditions, (3) a competitive checklist linking model availability and SLAs to procurement triggers. Rationale: Many existing PM research artifacts enumerate model features or pricing; customers make procurement choices based on nuanced trade-offs (latency SLOs, regional data controls, contract terms). This ticket synthesizes qualitative buyer interviews with synthetic telemetry experiments to produce concrete procurement triggers our sales and partnerships teams can use.
success_metrics: Completed persona matrix covering 12 buyer archetypes across 3 regions
Execution of 9 synthetic latency probe scenarios with observed failover latency and cost delta
A one-page procurement trigger checklist adopted by Sales and Solutions Engineering
At least 3 commitments from pilot customers to trial recommended fallback policies
approach: Phase 1: 8 qualitative interviews with procurement and platform leads across NA/EMEA/APAC to validate personas and procurement decision drivers. Phase 2: Design 9 synthetic probe scenarios (regional congestion, model-supply shock, quantization-fallback, multi-region routing) and run on our dedicated testbed and hosted API. Phase 3: Combine results into persona-trigger mappings and a short checklist for Sales/SE teams. Phase 4: Pilot the checklist with two enterprise accounts and capture feedback for iteration.
research_plan: Interview script focused on procurement thresholds, required SLAs, and fallback tolerances
Telemetry queries: per-route p95/p99, region hop penalties, unit-cost delta by quant/profile
Synthetic workload generator: 30m bursts, 1h sustained, and scheduled spike scenarios
Competitive scan: verify model availability, documented SLAs, and regional legal constraints
data_sources: Customer interview notes stored in Drive
Public vendor SLA docs and model catalogs
acceptance_criteria: Persona matrix vetted by Growth and Solutions Engineering
Latency probes executed and results documented in the runbook
Checklist reviewed and signed off by Sales lead
Pilot feedback captured and at least one actionable change identified
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Interview recruitment slippage — Mitigation: use Sales contacts + offer summary incentive
Risk: Synthetic probes may not reflect customer infra — Mitigation: parameterize probes and include ranges
Risk: Competitive docs out-of-date — Mitigation: snapshot artifacts and include source timestamps
